requested_result: Execute the already prepared Shipping stage-two content-verified representations through the existing CAP-0001/CAP-0002 Grounded Evidence path without requiring the Shipping worker to modify shared src, migrations or CI. Return persisted document identities, EvidenceFragment identities and an immutable execution/verification receipt; create zero FactAssertions and zero JudgmentAssertions.
parent_value: Complete the same single container-market-normalization-2022q3-to-2023 pilot while preserving the P146 seal, one-trajectory limit and existing Evidence semantics.

inputs.role: bounded claim scopes, source identity, known-at and representation provenance

constraints: Do not perform additional source discovery or add a second trajectory.
Do not require raw PDF bytes when the truthful content_verified readable representation is sufficient under existing CAP-0001/CAP-0002 semantics.
Do not treat the source-selection record, Search citation or model Memory as Evidence.
Do not create FactAssertions, JudgmentAssertions, Reality, Outcome or PIT replay in the Evidence execution transaction.
Do not reopen P146, execute P147 or consume a fourth blind-Memory probe.
Do not require the Shipping worker to modify src/**, migrations/**, shared CI, Capability Registry or main-owned control files.
acceptance: Exactly three prepared source representations are registered/archived with their pinned digests and truthful upstream-media provenance.

Exactly four bounded claim-scoped EvidenceFragments are grounded: one 2022 historical Reality candidate, one 2022 contemporaneous Judgment candidate, one Maersk 2023 later-outcome candidate, and one Hapag-Lloyd independent outcome corroboration candidate.
Persisted fragment locators and representation lineage are returned in an immutable execution result/receipt.
No shared semantic change is introduced merely to execute the existing capability.
dependency_consequence: Shipping stage-two is partial at Evidence preparation. Truth-bearing Reality/Judgment/Outcome composition and CAP-0005/CAP-0007 replay remain blocked until CAP-0002 execution returns verified EvidenceFragment identities.
recommended_minimal_fix: Use an existing integration-owned disposable execution surface or generic data-plane runner for scripts/execute_grounded_evidence_spec.py with the prepared repository representations as material-root input. If no such surface exists, global_serial should provide the smallest reusable execution adapter rather than a Shipping-specific semantic fork.
